decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records that the existing kitchen and common-bathroom arrangement is retained, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The decision concerns the separate common bathroom and kitchen locations, not the Unit 1 ensuite layout or its unresolved fixture fit.
Retaining the Unit 1 kitchen and common-bathroom locations does not change the existing drainage-alignment constraints or the Unit 3 drain requirements.
The source decision does not change allocation of the WC or common-vestibule area to Unit 1, nor does it resolve the entry area's intended use.
The source decision is limited to the Unit 1 common bathroom and kitchen arrangement and does not alter the Unit 3 bathroom layout.
The Unit 2 bathroom position and door requirement remain unchanged by the Unit 1 location decision.
Retaining the common bathroom's location does not determine the bathroom door type, swing direction, or unresolved sink-clearance conflict.
The Unit 3 bathroom-door and kitchen-counter clearance requirement is independent of the Unit 1 common-bathroom location decision.
The decision not to swap the kitchen and common bathroom does not explicitly or necessarily change any recorded partition-wall construction or demolition instruction.
The source decision concerns the Unit 1 kitchen and common bathroom; it does not change the Unit 3 kitchen placement or bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The retained Unit 1 locations do not change the task-local sketch's artifact type, purpose, or required content categories.
The location decision does not change the dwelling count or Unit 1's 2+1 configuration.
